producer_report.summary: Added athena-core's exploration module. It models a Dionysus bounded experiment (hypothesis, approach, bound, outcome). `validate` refuses an empty hypothesis, an empty approach or a zero bound. `conclude` reports Stopped when the steps spent exceed the bound. OLY-2-15 in docs/spec.toml now names this module as its mechanism, with a measure that names the test and ends `status: not shown`. CHANGELOG.md has an entry. The 5 exploration tests, the 81 hestia tests and the policy test pass; I left clippy and the full suite to Athena.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml entry OLY-2-15 has a mechanism naming crates/athena-core/src/exploration.rs (not "none"), keeps owner "Dionysus", and a measure ending with `status: not shown` that names the test (cargo test -p athena-core exploration). Check with Grep on docs/spec.toml.
criteria_check.evidence: Edited the entry: mechanism names exploration.rs, owner unchanged, measure names `cargo test -p athena-core exploration` and ends `status: not shown`. Hestia spec tests pass.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/exploration.rs exists, is declared in crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs, and defines a bounded-experiment type (hypothesis, unconventional approach, bound, outcome) with a validate function.
criteria_check.evidence: Created file with Experiment{hypothesis,approach,bound,outcome} and validate; `pub mod exploration;` added to lib.rs; it compiles.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core exploration`: tests show that an experiment with no bound or an empty hypothesis is refused, that a bounded one is accepted, and that an experiment which exceeds its bound is reported as stopped. Each test fails if validate is stubbed to accept everything.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran it: 5 passed. Each test asserts an Err or a Stopped result that depends on validate (conclude calls validate), except the accepted case, which asserts Ok. Stubbing validate to Ok(()) breaks the three refusal tests and the zero-bound check in the last test. I did not run the stub.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test`: all pass. This includes the existing spec tests in hestia.rs and xtask that parse docs/spec.toml.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran cargo fmt --all, the hestia tests and the xtask policy test, all passing.

learnings: The producer shell hook blocks head and tail; use the Read tool.
CHANGELOG.md has many `### Added` headings, so edits need surrounding context.
